message_lines: OOTP Consultation task. Read and carry out the task at {task_ref}; it is the source of truth for this run.
Read {base_profile_ref}, then your role profile, before acting.

Git delivery is what the task's Delivery section and its stated Git authority allow: one task branch, scoped commits, a push and one draft pull request, all through the hub's github_task operations. The owner merges; a launch never authorizes a merge.
